learning_objectives.en: Write and self-review a 250+ word advantages/disadvantages essay using a concrete rubric.
learning_objectives.vi: Viết và tự soát bài lợi–hại từ 250 từ theo rubric cụ thể.

content.en: Spend about 5–8 minutes planning. Use roughly 35–40 minutes for the task. A good answer addresses both sides, develops examples, groups ideas logically and uses accurate linking. A sample is a learning tool, not a guaranteed band score.
content.vi: Dành khoảng 5–8 phút lập dàn ý trong ~40 phút làm bài. Bài tốt nêu cả hai phía, ví dụ và bố cục hợp lý, từ nối chính xác. Bài mẫu không bảo đảm band.

instruction.en: Write at least 250 words on the advantages and disadvantages of employees working from home rather than commuting to an office.
instruction.vi: Viết tối thiểu 250 từ về lợi và hại làm việc từ xa so với đến văn phòng.

questions.prompt_en: More employees are working from home rather than commuting to an office. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this trend? (250+ words)
questions.prompt_vi: Ngày càng nhiều người làm việc tại nhà. Xu hướng này có lợi và hại gì? (250+ từ)

answer.model_en:
In recent years, a growing number of employees have started to work from home for at least part of the week instead of commuting to an office. This trend has clear benefits for both workers and employers, but it also creates some significant problems.

The most obvious advantage of working from home is the time and money saved on commuting. Someone who spends an hour travelling each way gains ten hours a week, which can be used for rest, exercise or family. Remote work also allows companies to reduce the cost of office space and to recruit talented staff who live far from the city. In addition, many employees find that they can concentrate better at home, away from the noise and interruptions of an open-plan office, which may increase their productivity.

On the other hand, working from home has several drawbacks. Many people feel isolated when they rarely see colleagues, and this can affect both their wellbeing and their sense of belonging to the company. Young employees may suffer most, because they learn a great deal by watching and asking experienced colleagues, which is harder to do online. Furthermore, when the home becomes the workplace, it can be difficult to separate work from private life, and some people end up working longer hours rather than shorter ones.

In conclusion, working from home offers valuable savings in time and cost and can improve concentration, but it may also lead to loneliness, slower learning for new staff and longer working hours. A combination of home and office work may therefore be the most effective arrangement for many organisations.
answer.model_vi: Bài mẫu: Mở bài nêu xu hướng. Thân lợi: tiết kiệm thời gian/chi phí, năng suất. Thân hại: cô lập, mất ranh giới thời gian, khó phối hợp. Kết: cân nhắc theo ngành và hoàn cảnh.

questions.explanation_en: The model examines the two sides, uses supported ideas and a conclusion; compare development, cohesion and accuracy using the rubric.
questions.explanation_vi: Bài mẫu bàn cả hai phía, có ví dụ và kết luận; đối chiếu độ phát triển, liên kết và độ chính xác bằng rubric.

instruction.en: Write 250+ words on robots taking over jobs.
instruction.vi: Viết từ 250 từ về robot thay công việc.

questions.prompt_en: Robots may perform many tasks currently done by people. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this change.
questions.prompt_vi: Robot có thể làm nhiều công việc hiện do người đảm nhận. Bàn lợi và hại.

answer.model_en:
Some people argue that advanced robots will increasingly take over tasks currently performed by employees. This development could improve the efficiency of many industries, but it may also create serious problems for people whose jobs can be automated.

One major advantage is that machines can carry out repetitive and dangerous tasks with great consistency. In manufacturing, for instance, a robot can inspect products for defects without becoming tired. In industries such as mining or chemical processing, automation may also prevent workers from being exposed to harmful conditions. Another benefit is lower operating costs over time. Although robots are expensive to purchase and maintain, businesses can use them continuously, which may reduce errors and allow staff to concentrate on more creative or interpersonal work.

However, the disadvantages should not be overlooked. The most significant concern is job displacement, especially among workers who have limited access to retraining. A machine that replaces an entire group of routine tasks can affect families and local communities, not just individual employees. Furthermore, automated systems still depend on people to design, monitor and repair them. A technical failure or a poorly programmed decision could therefore interrupt essential services, while smaller firms may struggle with the initial investment.

In my view, the benefits of workplace robots are substantial, but they depend on how the transition is managed. Governments and employers should invest in practical retraining programmes and introduce machines gradually, allowing employees to move into new roles. Such an approach would help businesses become more productive without leaving large groups of workers behind.

Overall, robots could make work safer and more efficient, yet automation is not automatically beneficial to everyone. Careful planning and support for affected workers are necessary if society is to share its advantages fairly.
answer.model_vi: Bài mẫu cân bằng: lợi về an toàn, hiệu suất; hại về việc làm và chi phí; giải pháp đào tạo lại.

questions.explanation_vi: Bài mẫu có mở bài rõ, lập luận hai phía và kết luận có lý lẽ.

questions.prompt_en: Many university students undertake unpaid internships to gain experience. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this practice.
questions.prompt_vi: Nhiều sinh viên thực tập không lương để tích lũy kinh nghiệm. Hãy bàn lợi ích và bất lợi.

answer.model_en:
In many countries, students are encouraged to gain experience through unpaid internships before applying for a full-time position. These placements may provide useful opportunities, but their disadvantages are particularly serious for young people who cannot afford to work without a salary.

One major advantage is that an internship can introduce students to a real professional environment. A university course may teach the theory of marketing, for example, whereas an internship allows students to observe how a campaign is planned, discussed and evaluated. This experience may help them decide whether a particular career suits their interests. Another benefit is the chance to build professional relationships. An intern who learns from an experienced supervisor could receive feedback, practical advice and references for future applications.

However, unpaid placements can also create financial pressure. Students still need to pay for transport, meals and accommodation, even if the company provides no salary. Some must take a second paid job, leaving them exhausted and less able to concentrate on their studies. More importantly, the system may be unfair. Students from wealthy families can accept a placement without worrying about living expenses, while equally talented students from poorer backgrounds may have to turn down the same opportunity. There is also a risk that some businesses use interns simply as a source of free labour instead of providing proper training.

A better approach would be to require clear learning objectives and reasonable compensation, even for short placements. Colleges could also help students find employers that offer structured supervision and useful tasks. This would preserve the educational value of internships while reducing the risk of exploitation.

In conclusion, unpaid internships can help young people understand a profession and expand their contacts, but they may cause financial hardship and unequal access. Carefully supervised, paid or subsidised placements would offer a fairer balance.
answer.model_vi: Bài mẫu nêu lợi về trải nghiệm, quan hệ nghề nghiệp; hại về áp lực tài chính, tiếp cận thiếu công bằng và nguy cơ bị lợi dụng; đề xuất đãi ngộ và giám sát.

guided.do: Tự dự đoán điều sẽ học trong “Independent Task 2: evidence and revision”: đọc yêu cầu sau và ghi một cách làm: Write an outline with an intro, two developed body paragraphs and conclusion BEFORE drafting the full essay.
Chọn 3–4 cụm thích hợp từ danh mục: career progression, supporting example, nevertheless, hybrid working arrangement, reskilling programme. Xem từ loại, nghĩa và thử đặt một câu.
Xử lý ví dụ A theo 3 câu hỏi: đề cần gì, bằng chứng là gì, bẫy ở đâu? Write an outline with an intro, two developed body paragraphs and conclusion BEFORE drafting the full essay.
Xử lý tình huống B độc lập trước khi xem lời giải: Write a non-repetitive conclusion.

coach.message: Bài “IELTS Writing Task 2 — independent production”: Viết và tự soát bài lợi–hại từ 250 từ theo rubric cụ thể. Trước khi thử, hãy nói một việc bạn sẽ kiểm tra ở bài này.

Bạn đang xem “career progression” (noun phrase), nghĩa là “sự thăng tiến nghề nghiệp”. Ví dụ: “Remote staff still need career progression.”. Hãy tạo một câu mới liên quan đến ielts writing task 2 — independent production thay vì chép lại.

Ở ví dụ có hướng dẫn “Write an outline with an intro, two developed body paragraphs and conclusion BEFORE drafting the full essay.”, hãy làm bước này trước: Phân loại đề rồi xác định đơn vị, mốc thời gian hoặc phạm vi yêu cầu. Chỉ mở mẫu sau khi tự thử.

Lỗi dễ gặp ở bài “IELTS Writing Task 2 — independent production”: Không tự gọi bài mẫu Band 7 hoặc thêm ví dụ số liệu chưa có nguồn. Viết outline trước giúp không bỏ yêu cầu, giữ mỗi body tập trung một luận điểm; bài mẫu chỉ hiện sau khi nộp.

Bạn đã hoàn thành bài “IELTS Writing Task 2 — independent production”. Hãy viết một câu theo khung rồi tự đọc lại; lưu cụm “career progression” nếu thực sự muốn dùng lại, rồi sửa một chỗ chưa chắc chắn trước khi làm bài mới.

Ở bài Independent Task 2: evidence and revision, trước tiên thử trả lời: Write an outline with an intro, two developed body paragraphs and conclusion BEFORE drafting the full essay. Đừng đoán vội; mình sẽ chỉ cách tìm dấu hiệu.
Hãy thử dùng “career progression” trong một câu. Cụm này là noun phrase, nghĩa là sự thăng tiến nghề nghiệp.
Gợi ý ngay trong ví dụ: Học thuộc toàn bài thường không hợp đề và kém tự nhiên. Hãy tìm điểm đó trong câu trước khi mở đáp án.
Lỗi thường gặp ở bài này: Không tự gọi bài mẫu Band 7 hoặc thêm ví dụ số liệu chưa có nguồn. Hãy sửa theo nguyên tắc: Summarises both sides; adds no unproven statistic.
Giờ kiểm lại cách làm Independent Task 2: evidence and revision: đối chiếu câu hỏi, lý do và nguồn. Thử câu mới: Draft ≥250 words, then annotate topic sentences and evidence.
